route.name: First nourishment
route.lesson: Green lobed desmids are food. Purple spiked cysts poison. Drag through any ready blue cells, return to the first, then release.

route.name: New life
route.lesson: Enclose the small pearl-colored spores to bring them home. Gather food as well. Orange hunters must not reach the mother.

route.name: The nursery
route.lesson: Feed the mother and remove three threats. Food thieves and hunters both count. The small bell bud inhales, then opens its gold center for capture. Watch its breath.

route.name: Small allies
route.lesson: Silver phages are helpers. Drag their cluster toward the copper bacterium. It ruptures after 9 seconds and releases stolen food. You can also capture the bacterium yourself.

route.name: The Bellwether
route.lesson: Like the bell bud, it draws food and poison inward, then opens for 16 seconds. Charge with three food and capture its gold center during the exhale. Repeat three times.

route.name: Clear a passage
route.lesson: A membrane containing ONLY cysts neutralizes them safely in this encounter. Separate the poison from food; mixed meals still hurt.

route.name: Turning tide
route.lesson: Feed from three different sectors. Amoebas can swallow a blue cell: loop around their gold nucleus within 15 seconds to rescue it. An eaten cell regrows next encounter.

route.name: Clearing the nursery
route.lesson: Capture purple cysts in poison-only loops. Feed using separate clean loops. Copper bacteria steal food. Push silver phages toward them; infected bacteria rupture after 9s, releasing stolen food.

route.name: Glass cradles
route.lesson: A glass cradle protects the first pearl. Capture both linked shields together, or the second within 18 seconds, then rescue the pearl. Rescue three spores in all.

route.name: The Glass Regent
route.lesson: Use what the glass cradle taught you: break both shields together, or the second within 18 seconds. Spend three food charge to hit the exposed nucleus.

route.name: Shared shelter
route.lesson: Remove four threats and gather food. Linked Twinspores share a membrane: both hearts must fit in your loop.

route.name: Violet shallows
route.lesson: Capture purple cysts in poison-only loops. Feed using separate clean loops. Copper bacteria steal food. Push silver phages toward them; infected bacteria rupture after 9s, releasing stolen food.

route.name: A clean current
route.lesson: Neutralize six cysts in poison-only loops. Keep a safe feeding route open while the deep current moves the colony.

route.name: Seeds of tomorrow
route.lesson: Bring four pearl spores home. Your evolved colony must balance feeding, protection, and rescue.

route.name: The Conjoined
route.lesson: Spend three food charge to enclose BOTH hearts. They spread farther after each hit; wait for them to meet, or draw a wider loop. Young pairs hatch nearby. Capture them before they reach Mother.
